card.name: Comma after a heading or inverted name
card.fires_on: The comma right after a headword or section title, where a second part of the title or the reversed surname-first name follows. It appears in cross-references, citations and label section headings.

modes.label: Inverted names and entries
modes.description: Comma after a surname or entry term in reference lists and dictionaries.
modes.example: Shirley Temple. See Temple<<,>> Shirley. Random House Unabridged Dictionary

modes.label: Label section cross-references
modes.description: Comma inside a section title in a bracketed or parenthetical "see" reference.

modes.label: Heading lists
modes.description: Comma after the first term in a list-style heading of drug classes or topics.

card.plain: It marks the comma that splits a title or a reversed name, like "Temple, Shirley" or "Addiction, Abuse, and Misuse".
